_doc: UNDERTOW character canon — machine-readable. This file is the single source of truth for character identity. Any art pipeline, human or automated, MUST read this before generating a character. Human-readable rationale lives in UNDERTOW-VISDEV-BRIEFS.md and UNDERTOW-ART-PROTOCOL.md.

no_breathing_apparatus.rule: No scuba tanks, oxygen tanks, regulators, rebreathers, or dive masks on ANY character in ANY frame.
no_breathing_apparatus.why: The entire power system is breath-hold freediving. Apparatus erases the premise.

no_costumes.rule: No capes, cloaks, flowing fabric, or superhero costuming. These are athletes.

reference_required.rule: A character may never be generated from a text description alone. The character's element_id MUST be embedded in the prompt as <<<element_id>>>, or the approved plate supplied as an image reference.
reference_required.why: Text-only prompts default to a generic pale figure. This erased Kai three consecutive times on 2026-07-25 before the rule existed.

visual_verification_required.rule: Every generated character asset MUST be visually inspected against this canon BEFORE being shown to the creator or committed. Off-model output is discarded, never presented as an option.
visual_verification_required.why: The creator should never be the quality filter.

element_source_must_show_baseline_state.rule: A character element MUST include at least one BASELINE reference: neutral daylight, plain background, character in their ordinary un-powered state. An element learns everything in its source plate as identity — it cannot tell a permanent trait from a temporary one.
element_source_must_show_baseline_state.why: Discovered twice on 2026-07-30. (1) Luna's element, built solely from a violet-twilight underwater plate, rendered her skin blue-lavender on a sunlit pool deck — it had learned the LIGHTING as skin tone. (2) Kai's element, built solely from the submerged pool-floor plate, carried the deep-blue Undertow eye-glow and water-cast teal hair onto a dry pool deck — it had learned a POWERED STATE as his face. The second is the worse failure: the glow is the visual tell that the Undertow is surfacing, so showing it on dry land breaks the power system itself.
element_source_must_show_baseline_state.how: Generate a baseline plate first — flat neutral daylight, plain grey background, no environmental cast, no active power, no story-state effects. Create the element with that reference FIRST and any atmospheric or powered plate second.
applies_to: environmental colour cast (lighting learned as skin tone)
state-dependent traits (eye glow, aura, transformation learned as permanent features)
momentary expression (closed eyes learned as a face that has no eyes)
camera and grade (dutch tilt, film grain, teal-orange learned as house style)
render style (a 3D-looking plate teaching 3D to a 2D show)
wet/dry hair and any other condition-specific rendering
element_source_must_show_baseline_state.founding_plate_rule: The founding plate is supplied as a SECOND reference only when it does not contradict canon. If it does — Mirei bare-faced, Gouda grinning, Bo in 3D — the element is built on the baseline alone. A plate can stay canon for provenance and still be too wrong to teach from.

kai.retired_reason: v1 was built solely from the submerged pool-floor plate, where the deep-blue Undertow eye-glow and water-cast teal hair are canon-correct. The element learned that POWERED STATE as his permanent face and carried the glow onto a dry pool deck in every crew render. v2 supplies a neutral dry-land baseline first (dark brown eyes, blue-black hair) plus the submerged plate second.

identity.heritage: Mixed Black — Japanese father (Daigo Isozaki), Jamaican mother
identity.hair: tightly-coiled blue-black, worn a little overgrown, falls toward his eyes; never straightened. NEVER teal, green or turquoise — that is water light, not hair colour
identity.eyes: ordinary dark brown on dry land. The deep-blue Undertow glow appears ONLY when he is submerged — it is the visual tell that the power is surfacing, so it must never appear on a pool deck, in a classroom, or anywhere dry
identity.build: lean, slightly under-muscled — a body that hasn't been allowed to train
identity.signature_prop: shell-cord bracelet that was his late mother's; never removed
identity.height_rationale: 15 and 'a body that hasn't been allowed to train' — visibly the smallest of the swimmers, with room to grow.

wardrobe: school uniform with sleeves pulled over hands
forbidden: blue or luminous eyes on dry land
kai.notes: His heritage is SHOWN, never stated in dialogue. Off-model = discarded, never shown for approval.

identity.skin: pale ordinary human skin — never blue or violet; that was twilight, not his complexion
identity.hair: blue-black, precise tight undercut / short fade
identity.eyes: silver-gray; cold Kuroshio silver when submerged
identity.build: textbook sprint-freestyle — broad shoulders, tapered waist, immaculate posture
identity.height_rationale: 16, textbook sprint-freestyle build: broad shoulders, tapered waist.

wardrobe: black House Kurose tracksuit with small silver wave-and-torii crest
forbidden: blue or violet skin from environmental light
ren.notes: Carries villain-grade menace early so his mid-series turn to ally lands. He is not the villain.
ren.retired_reason: v1 was built solely from the twilight fence plate. Magenta sky and cyan pool uplight sat on his face as skin tone, and the chest-up crop gave the element no body reference at all. v2 adds a neutral-daylight three-view turnaround.

identity.hair: short locs tied back with a green-gold-black wrap
identity.eyes: warm brown and OPEN by default; river-gold only when submerged. His race plate has them shut mid-laugh — that is one expression, not his face
identity.build: pure sprinter — long levers, loose easy shoulders
identity.signature: radiant grin; swims to a beat only he hears. His kit is visibly older and hand-repaired — Freewater has no Pillar and no institution behind it, so the kit is handed down, not issued. Set against Ren's immaculate new House Kurose blacks, that contrast IS the argument.

wardrobe: charcoal-black Freewater House tracksuit — thin green-and-gold piping down sleeves and legs, small gold House sigil at the left chest (comb crossed over a drum, above a broken chain)
Freewater second-skin with the same House sigil for racing
forbidden: Jamaican flag print, saltire or diagonal cross on clothing
large block colour panels — heritage is carried as thin piping and the House sigil, never as a flag
new or pristine kit — it is mended and passed down
kemar.notes: Cultural specifics to be built with Jamaican tradition-keepers before public release. The flag-singlet design was retired on 2026-07-31 for reading as costume rather than uniform; heritage now shows through palette, sigil and the loc wrap.
kemar.retired_reason: Retired twice. v1 (dd39c0c5) was built solely from the race plate: eyes shut mid-laugh, wet specular skin, dutch tilt, heavy teal-orange grade — the element had never seen his eyes. v2 (c78435b0) fixed all of that but kept the Jamaican-flag racing kit, which read as a COSTUME beside a cast that otherwise wears believable athletic wear with a small House crest; he was the only character in the show dressed as a flag. v3 replaces it with the Freewater House tracksuit and keeps the corrected face.
kemar.founding_plate_excluded_why: The race plate has his eyes shut AND the retired flag kit, so it is NOT supplied as a second reference. It remains the checksummed approved plate for provenance.

identity.build: HEAVYSET, round-and-mighty, tall and broad — fisherman's mass, breaststroker's barrel chest
identity.signature: enormous open-hearted grin; moves like he's careful not to break the world
identity.render_style: flat 2D cel-shaded anime — NEVER a 3D or CG render. His original plate was 3D-styled and is off-house-style
identity.height_rationale: 16, 'HEAVYSET... tall and broad' — the tallest of the teenagers.

bo.notes: Generation note: keep Bo fully clothed and lead prompts with 'wholesome' — the content filter trips on him otherwise. The crew-key-visual ALT take renders him lanky and is OFF-MODEL.
bo.retired_reason: v1 CONTRADICTED HOUSE STYLE: it was a semi-3D CG render, not 2D anime, with his eyes closed and a heavy green-gold sunset cast, plus garbled watermark text. v2 is baseline-only, drawn in flat 2D cel-shaded anime with his eyes open; the old plate is deliberately excluded.
bo.founding_plate_excluded_why: The founding plate contradicts canon, so it is NOT supplied as a second reference. It remains the checksummed approved plate for provenance and history, but the element is built on the baseline alone.

identity.skin: pale ivory human skin — NEVER blue, purple, lavender or grey; only her HAIR is silver-white
identity.hair: very long silver-white, worn loose; haloes around her underwater
identity.signature: small white ceremonial dot-markings at the brow; water-calm everywhere

wardrobe: modest full-length white ama diving robe with indigo wave stitching
luna.retired_reason: v1 was built from a single underwater violet-twilight plate. The element baked the environmental colour cast in as her SKIN TONE — she rendered blue-lavender on a sunlit pool deck. v2 is built on a neutral-daylight baseline reference.
luna.known_gap: The v2 element currently holds ONLY the neutral baseline plate — the violet-twilight underwater plate did not attach on creation. Recorded rather than hidden. Renders are correct, but her underwater signature look must be carried by prompt text until a second reference is added.

identity.hair: dark bob with one longer asymmetric strand she chews when calculating
identity.eyes: narrow and intelligent, behind CLEAR PRESCRIPTION GLASSES worn ON THE FACE at all times — never sunglasses, never pushed up on her head, never bare-faced
identity.height_rationale: 15, 'compact, precise backstroker' — the smallest of the cast.

wardrobe: navy federation tracksuit zipped to the chin
forbidden: eyewear pushed up on the head
mirei.retired_reason: v1 CONTRADICTED CANON: it showed her bare-faced with sunglasses pushed up on her head and large round eyes, when canon requires prescription glasses on her face over narrow intelligent eyes. That is why eyewear kept migrating to her head in crew shots. v2 is baseline-only; the old plate is deliberately excluded so it cannot re-teach the error.
mirei.founding_plate_excluded_why: The founding plate contradicts canon, so it is NOT supplied as a second reference. It remains the checksummed approved plate for provenance and history, but the element is built on the baseline alone.

identity.face: heavy jaw, broken nose, several days of stubble
identity.build: a ruin of a magnificent athlete — huge shoulders, gone soft at the middle
identity.signature: weary slouch, but eyes that never stopped being sharp and haunted
identity.eyes: ordinary dark brown — never yellow, amber or gold
identity.height_rationale: 44, a ruin of a magnificent athlete; a former Olympic champion's frame.

signature_props: Olympic gold medal used as a bottle opener
gouda.retired_reason: v1 CONTRADICTED CANON: he was grinning broadly with yellow-amber eyes, seated, under a heavy sepia interior cast. Canon forbids a cheerful demeanour and gives him ordinary dark eyes. v2 is baseline-only; the old plate is deliberately excluded.
gouda.founding_plate_excluded_why: The founding plate contradicts canon, so it is NOT supplied as a second reference. It remains the checksummed approved plate for provenance and history, but the element is built on the baseline alone.

identity.heritage: Japanese, House Ryn, former Fathom Games champion
identity.skin: sea-worn and weathered — never grey or desaturated; that was the storm, not his complexion
identity.hair: dark, damp, single grey streak at the temple
identity.eyes: a shade too dark and deep — the ONLY hint of what he became
identity.signature: faint old scar at the throat
identity.height_rationale: 38, 'tall, powerful, immense controlled stillness' — the tallest figure in the show.

nakaru.notes: LOCKED DIRECTION: grounded, not fantasy. The menace is stillness, not effects. Expression is calm grief and conviction — a man who has already decided. Earlier fantasy-styled versions were rejected by the creator.
nakaru.retired_reason: v1 was built solely from the storm sea-wall plate: desaturated overcast grade, face in shadow, and neither signature feature legible. v2 adds a neutral-daylight plate where the grey temple streak and throat scar are both visible for the first time.

_height_chart_note: Heights added 2026-07-31. They were NOT in the source bible — a cast lineup cannot be drawn without relative height, so they had to be decided, and they are recorded here so every future artist works from the same numbers rather than re-guessing. Each one is derived from the build description already in canon (see identity.height_rationale). They are a proposal open to revision by the creator; if any change, rerun docs/assets/undertow/build-lineup.py to regenerate the chart.
